{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FULL-TEST-20260907-NEW-01",
  "department": "CLOTHING",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "clothing_decisions": {
    "identity_support": "Treat canonical Inaria identity, age presentation, body proportions, facial landmarks, and canonical hairstyle as locked inputs. Clothing must support recognition and must not redefine the character.",
    "scope": "Test-only clothing validation; no production assets, final wardrobe package, or generation outputs are authorized.",
    "locked_requirements": [
      "Do not alter or obscure recognizable Inaria facial features, canonical hair identity, or established age presentation.",
      "Do not infer permanent body, age, hairstyle, or identity changes from fit, silhouette, pose, camera angle, lighting, or styling.",
      "Use plausible garment construction, fit, layering, closures, materials, and contact points.",
      "Maintain clean intersections between clothing, hair, body, hands, footwear, and accessories.",
      "Avoid garments or accessories that create anatomy ambiguity, fused limbs, hidden hands, malformed joints, unstable silhouettes, or identity drift.",
      "Preserve JSON-only downstream handoff compatibility.",
      "Record clothing decisions and validation results in the shared GitHub traceability record once the authoritative repository path is supplied."
    ],
    "adjustable_choices": [
      "Season, occasion, location, palette, silhouette, layering, footwear, accessories, fabric weight, and styling may be adjusted after the canonical character manifest is repaired.",
      "Hairstyle interaction may be coordinated through neckline, collar, hood, hat, scarf, or hair-accessory placement, but canonical hairstyle and hairline must remain unchanged unless explicitly authorized.",
      "Wardrobe complexity may be reduced when needed to improve anatomy, identity preservation, or generation reliability."
    ],
    "controlled_diversity_plan": [
      "Vary wardrobe intentionally across seasonal, practical, casual, formal, and location-appropriate looks.",
      "Vary color, silhouette, footwear, and accessories without permanently locking one outfit, shoe, accessory, or color.",
      "Prefer a stable core of recognizable styling cues while changing non-identifying garments and combinations.",
      "Avoid excessive patterns, reflective details, layered hardware, long loose straps, intricate jewelry, and other high-risk details unless specifically required for the test case.",
      "Ensure each variation remains practical, anatomically clear, and compatible with pose and camera requirements."
    ],
    "stability_controls": [
      "Use clear garment boundaries and moderate layering.",
      "Keep sleeves, hems, waistbands, shoes, and accessories structurally unambiguous.",
      "Avoid extreme oversized or body-conforming garments that distort proportions or obscure joints.",
      "Keep hands, wrists, ankles, knees, and facial landmarks unobstructed where anatomy validation is required.",
      "Use footwear with plausible left-right construction, visible soles when appropriate, and stable ground contact.",
      "Reject any variation that causes clothing-body fusion, impossible folds, missing closures, asymmetric footwear errors, accessory duplication, or silhouette instability."
    ],
    "handoff_requirements": [
      "Receive the repaired canonical CHARACTER manifest before approving clothing against identity.",
      "Pass clothing constraints separately from character identity constraints to SCENE, POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, and DIRECTOR.",
      "Mark every wardrobe element as locked, adjustable, intentionally varied, or unresolved.",
      "Require downstream validation of clothing intersections, anatomy visibility, identity preservation, and generation stability."
    ]
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Canonical Inaria identity must remain unchanged.",
    "Canonical facial landmarks, distinctive features, age presentation, body proportions, skin tone, and core hair identity must not be modified by wardrobe decisions.",
    "Clothing must support rather than define Inaria identity.",
    "No permanent outfit, shoe, accessory, hairstyle interaction, or color lock is established by this test.",
    "Garments and accessories must have plausible construction and clean intersections.",
    "Anatomy, identity preservation, and generation stability take priority over decorative complexity.",
    "No production assets may be created.",
    "JSON-only output is required.",
    "GitHub traceability is required, but the authoritative repository path and canonical identity record are currently missing."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Seasonal wardrobe changes.",
    "Occasion-appropriate casual, formal, practical, and location-specific styling.",
    "Controlled variation in garment silhouette, color palette, layering, footwear, and accessories.",
    "Non-identifying accessory and material variation where it does not obscure the face, hair identity, hands, joints, or body proportions.",
    "Hairstyle-compatible neckline, collar, hood, scarf, and headwear choices that do not alter the canonical hairstyle or hairline.",
    "Simplified wardrobe variants for anatomy and generation-stability testing."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "CLOTHING cannot complete a PASS because CHARACTER is in REPAIR and the authoritative canonical Inaria reference, locked trait manifest, age/version record, and GitHub path were not supplied.",
    "Do not approve clothing-to-identity validation, full handoff validation, or final integration status until DIRECTOR attaches the repaired CHARACTER manifest.",
    "After repair, test at least one stable baseline outfit and multiple controlled wardrobe variations across season, occasion, silhouette, footwear, and accessories.",
    "OpenAI failover routing, JSON-only enforcement, identity checks, anatomy checks, generation-stability checks, cross-department handoffs, and GitHub traceability remain unresolved at the CLOTHING stage.",
    "No production assets were created."
  ]
}
